description: Local Git hooks with GitHub MCP PR publication and verified PostToolUse responses.

hooks.command: python -X utf8 -c "import pathlib, runpy, subprocess, sys; root = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', '--show-toplevel'], text=True, encoding='utf-8').strip(); script = str(pathlib.Path(root) / 'scripts' / 'codex_git_flow.py'); sys.argv = [script, 'hook']; runpy.run_path(script, run_name='__main__')"
